title: How We HBCYOU: P&G and Its Brands Take Campus Culture on the Road
summary: Bringing everyday essentials, immersive experiences, and cultural storytelling back to the yard four of the tour, now powered by HBCU GO.
body_markdown:
College years are some of the best, brightest and busiest!


Late night cram sessions, football games and all the big life lessons that help you show up and grow up — from laundry pile ups to kitchen messes — spark favorite memories of your home away from home. P&G and our brands are here to help college students win — from freshman firsts to graduation and beyond.


For generations, P&G has built brands that people love by understanding and serving the unique needs of everyone across every life stage — from childhood milestones to adulting adjustments, and more. This includes supporting students as they embark on the incredible journey through college and beyond.


One of the ways we do this is with our **HBCYOU Program** , which is back on the yard with the ultimate **'How We HBCYOU Playbook'** . This interactive experience at back to school, homecomings and football classics this fall is packed with insights, giveaways and games designed to help students live their best college life.


## Keeping It Clean by Conquering Everyday Dorm Life Routines


Dorm life is a huge part of the college experience and where independence often begins. We understand that keeping a space clean and comfortable can feel like a whole new course. P&G and our brands have everything needed to navigate the "firsts" that help students grow up and establish the routines that keep their space feeling like home.
